objective_for_doctor:
Age: 76
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I have pain in my chest—on both the right and left sides and in the upper chest/area around the breast—and it’s also in the epigastric area. The pain feels tedious, heavy, and exhausting, with intensity around 5 out of 10. It radiates under my jaw and to my trachea and also toward my right triceps and right shoulder. It gets worse with physical exertion and improves with rest.
When did this pain first begin, and how long does each episode typically last?
Do you experience shortness of breath, sweating, nausea, or lightheadedness during these episodes?
Do you have any history of high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, smoking, or a family history of early heart disease?

Yes—I have diabetes, high blood pressure (and I take medications to treat high blood pressure), and high cholesterol (and I take medications to treat high cholesterol). I also have had a heart attack or angina (chest pain).
Does this pain feel similar to your previous angina or heart attack episodes?
[DDX] Acute coronary syndrome, Stable angina pectoris, Gastroesophageal reflux disease, Cervical radiculopathy, Musculoskeletal chest pain
